description: Render one semantic yes, no, or unknown table cell with a visible status and subdued MediaWiki colors.
documentation_wikitext:
__NOTOC__
Render one semantic yes, no, or unknown table cell with a visible status and subdued MediaWiki colors.

== Usage ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{| class="wikitable"
| {{Table cell status|status=yes|text=Supported}}
|}
</syntaxhighlight>

Omit optional parameters that do not apply. The parameter reference below lists supported names and aliases.

examples.description: Two status cells in a wikitable row.

parameters.description: Optional cell text; an explicitly empty value produces a blank cell.
parameters.label: Text
parameters.name: text
